job_description:
This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Senior Software Engineer - REMOTE. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work on innovative solutions that power durable execution for demanding AI and enterprise systems. You will join a team that is focused on building a reliable foundation for developers and enhancing their experience through world-class open-source software. Your contributions will impact how compute is managed in the cloud, ensuring seamless functionality for various execution environments. If you are passionate about technology and eager to be part of a collaborative team, we would love to hear from you.
Accountabilities
• Create new managed compute primitives with clean APIs.
• Design autoscaling systems for predictable worker fleet scaling.
• Define architecture for cohesive compute capabilities across platforms.
• Architect and operate high-performance task execution services.
• Manage cloud integrations including secure networking and IAM boundaries.
• Implement operational features like SLOs and load testing.
• Drive end-to-end delivery of API design and rollout strategies.
• Lead design documentation and technical reviews.
• Influence cross-team platform changes.
Requirements
• Experience in building distributed systems or multi-tenant platforms.
• Strong understanding of concurrency, performance, and reliability.
• Proven ability to ship platform primitives like APIs or control planes.
• Comfort in managing outcomes, including incident responses.
• Excellent written communication skills.
• Experience in Go is a plus.
• Familiarity with cloud infrastructure platforms is desirable.
• Knowledge of IAM/security boundaries for cloud execution models.
Benefits
• Unlimited PTO, 12 Holidays + 2 Floating Holidays.
• 100% Premiums Coverage for Medical, Dental, and Vision.
• Life Insurance, AD&D, and Disability benefits.
• 401K Plan with empowerment features.
• Perks for Professional Development and Learning.
• Internet Stipend and In-Home Office Setup support.
• $3,600/year for Work from Home Meals.
• Access to Calm App for mental wellness.
Why Apply Through Jobgether?
We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
